history.overview: Hollows West became the primary Muramite staging ground within the Hollows.

timeline.name: Mining Expansion
timeline.description: Dragorn miners expanded westward to create broad caverns for extraction.

timeline.name: Muramite Occupation
timeline.description: Muramite forces converted the western caverns into staging grounds.

timeline.name: Resistance Infiltration
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels established side passages to infiltrate Muramite camps.

timeline.name: Discord Pockets
timeline.description: Localized Discord pockets formed, destabilizing parts of the caverns.
